summary: Corrected the second and last operand transposition found by auditing every fact against its receipts: the client-change fact cited log index 110 for the configuration entry in the leader's own log, while its receipt records index 106 — 110 belongs to the five-voter discard case, whose shape is similar enough to invite the confusion. The statement and conditions now cite 106, the premise note records where the wrong index came from, and the audit confirmed that every other quoted operand across the cast of facts matches its receipt: voter counts, server sets and configuration indices, payload presence and counts, terms and states, adoption counts, control outcomes, and both reproductions of the partition result. The substantive account is unchanged — the question remains explained with the defect claim asserted, no gaps open, and the remaining items the recorded store and fault-model limitations (disk-backed commit-tracking stores, crash and restart timing, further repetitions or longer runs).
